name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, your eyes have turned into yen signs~」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, stop throwing a fit. We're going to the Student Council room.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's going on, Synn?! This isn't what you said at ALL!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, it's not like I can defy her.」

name: Synn
message: 「She'd chop us into three fillets with that hand-blade of hers. Speaking of sashimi, it's time for the wasabi to shine.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr--! What good is the Student Council then--?!」

name: Synn
message: 「It can't be helped, it's not like it's a regular event. Besides, cake has nothing to do with this.」

name: Synn
message: 「You were calling it cake yourself until just now...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I know! We just have to make it a Student Council rule. Allocate budget for the social gathering!」

name: Synn
message: 「No way. You're the only one who'd be happy with that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You'd be happy too! Since you wouldn't have to spend your own money!」

name: Synn
message: 「We can manage fine even without money.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, right, you *would* be that kind of gentleman.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Which means you actually have a brilliant idea?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nope. Isn't that what Everyone's getting together to figure out right now?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For once, why don't you shock the school with one of your clever ideas?」
It's a special social gathering. It'd be great if we had something to help us get even closer with Everyone...
Lolotte was the first to arrive.
Using her chair like a cradle, she was gracefully nodding off.
A cute pig ornament was sitting on her lap.
She really is obsessed with food.

name: Nanaka
message: 「No one else is here yet, so why not just let her sleep?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, well, our class doesn't have homeroom.」

name: Synn
message: 「So it can't be helped that you're always behind us.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Besides, running in the hallway is dangerous.」
Lolotte really is soothing to be around.

name: Synn
message: 「She is a third-year, after all. I'm sure she has a lot on her plate.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are we doing today? Is it canceled after all?」

name: Misa
message: 「After pushing that motion through, there's no way we can just cancel it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course. Once we've decided to do it, we have to see it through.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look at you talking big, Mr. Student Council President. Don't tell me you came up with a brilliant idea?」

name: Misa
message: 「Pathetic. Surely there are things we can do even without a budget.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're saying the exact same thing Synn said.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, I wish some money would just tumble out from somewhere...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to be that startled, jeez.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Shaking the world with pure greed--as expected of Synn-sama's childhood friend.」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That pig-shaped ornament. You always carry it with you, but what on earth is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「If there's money inside... could it be a piggy bank?」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like Lolotte and I would get along great.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Pretty sure your reasons are in completely opposite directions, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, I'm not giving you Tontoro! This is extremely precious to me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan. Forget the money, just give us a great idea to liven up the welcome party.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So Senpai is our only hope, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, we haven't heard Nanaka's idea yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I won't force you if you don't have one...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, you could show a little faith in me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright, fine. If you're gonna go that far, I'll show you what I've got!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'll bring some soba from my family's shop!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Careful, careful! You'll break the piggy bank!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine. It's much sturdier than it looks.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I just mean I won't step into pathetic traps like the rest of you.」

name: Misa
message: 「Using both hands to look exasperated... Is that really wise?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, I didn't! I meant I wouldn't break it for a foolish reason like stumbling, slipping, or falling!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now, now, let's just pick up the pieces, hurry!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Luckily, the fragments are big. Let's just put adhesive bandages on them for now.」
I see. Since she's broken it so many times, she's surprisingly used to this.

name: Ria
message: 「My sister told me to bring this...」

name: Ria
message: 「She said if it's a party, there's no other choice.」
Did a young lady from a prestigious family just run all the way here holding a clay pot in her hands?

name: Ria
message: 「Hot, hot, hot! Move, move! The pot's gonna boil over! Hot, hot, hot!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's wonderful, Ria-chan. You truly are the Princess of Hot Pot... daze!」

name: Synn
message: 「A pot, huh. I guess it means we should throw a hot pot party.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What about the ingredients? What are we gonna put in it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「If everyone brings something, it won't cost much money and it'll be super cheap.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Could it be, is that what they commonly call--」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Anybody looking at that pot would think the same thing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wahahaha! Sounds great, in for a penny, in for a pound!」

name: Synn
message: 「I said it's not set in stone that it's poison yet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A hot pot party! Just thinking about what kind of food we'll make gets me so excited!」

name: Misa
message: 「Aren't you lively. You were asleep until just a moment ago.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I'm so full of energy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You must've really been looking forward to it. You were the first one here, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「So, everyone gathers their own ingredients and meets at the school gate. Is that okay, Synn-kun?」

name: Ria
message: 「It's my first time visiting your house. Please show us the way.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hehehe, that's way too naive, like putting mayonnaise on melon soda. Do you really think Nanaka-chan here would pull such a 'cliche stunt'?」
An unspoken agreement that normal ingredients are off-limits--!?

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, just one warning. Anything inedible is against the rules, okay? Like a plushie or something.」
